_comment: Committed baseline for test-impeccable.mjs. Total findings on this worktree after the round-5 phase-2 design-system pass, scanning `index.html css/app.css app/src` with `impeccable detect --no-advisory --json`. The gate fails if the count rises above `total`. Main's pre-pass baseline (reported by the orchestrator) was 115: 64 low-contrast, 26 side-tab, 10 dark-glow, 7 undersized-ui-text, 4 tiny-text, 2 ai-color-palette, 1 marquee, 1 layout-transition. This pass fixed a real low-contrast regression it introduced along the way (white text on the dark-mode --primary/--accent/--primary-hover teal, and a few color:var(--primary) TEXT usages that needed --ink instead) and, net, also cleared a handful of PRE-EXISTING low-contrast findings the new --danger/--on-brand realignment happened to fix — landing 5 below where main started. side-tab / dark-glow / undersized-ui-text / tiny-text / layout-transition are untouched (component/markup-structural, not token-value issues — later packages, not this one, own them). The 2 ai-color-palette hits are both #5b21b6, the spec-approved holiday-purple (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-23-design-system-design.md: "purple means holiday and nothing else") — a deliberate design decision the tool cannot tell apart from an accidental one; later packages should mark it accepted via .impeccable/config.json rather than chase it to 0. Later packages (S, K, V, C, I, A, G, M, D) own shrinking this toward 0 as they rewrite each page.
